design_name: Collagen Evidence Atlas: Guarded 3D Benchmark & Metrology Workbench (Pos008)

existing_viewer_deficiencies: Two static 2D projected panels flatten a 353.82 x 353.82 x 356.63 µm volume containing 14,400 grid nodes and 753 cell boundary points, causing severe depth occlusion and hiding how residual errors cluster radially around the guarded interior.

Pre-rendered bar images and a basic model dropdown decouple global summary metrics from spatial inspection; users cannot see why buckling-only (RMSE 0.879195) outperforms combined (RMSE 0.897603) or where sliding-only (RMSE 1.308340) fails.
Lack of interactive vector differencing forces users to visually subtract dense arrow fields across separate panels, which is perceptually impossible for small displacement magnitudes.
candidate_experience_strengths: Synchronized GPU-rendered 3D views (Observed, Predicted, Residual) directly address the mental-subtraction problem and expose spatial error anisotropy across the 8 octants.
Axis-aligned slab slicing and octant filtering transform an unreadable 3D point/vector cloud into an inspectable tomographic workbench.
Linking a clickable global score chart with a conditional local error histogram bridges summary benchmark tables and node-level residuals without requiring runtime solver execution.

candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.flaw: 3D Vector Hairball & Occlusion in Triptych View
candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.critique: Rendering all 14,400 nodes or even all 4,355 score-eligible vectors simultaneously across three smaller side-by-side WebGL canvases will produce overlapping arrow shafts that obscure the 753-point reference cell.
candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.design_fix: Default the 3D view to the 4,355 score-eligible nodes within an active 60 µm tomographic slab (with a one-click 'Full Box' toggle), use zoom-adaptive instanced glyph scaling, and provide a 'Single-Canvas Difference Lens' mode that renders direct residual vectors (u_pred - u_obs) at 100% viewport width.

candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.flaw: Metric Contradiction Between Global Score and Filtered Histogram
candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.critique: The frozen benchmark global vector RMSE (e.g., 0.897603 for Combined) is an equal-weighted mean across the 8 octants, whereas an interactive histogram of visible nodes naturally computes a node-pooled RMSE. Displaying both without strict visual separation will make users think the calculation is broken when all 8 octants are selected.
candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.design_fix: Architect a dual-ledger metric header: a locked 'Frozen Benchmark Score (8-Octant Equal Mean)' badge paired with a dynamically updating 'Active Subset Metric (Node-Pooled RMSE, n = X / 4,355)' readout, bridged by an 8-octant spark-matrix showing per-octant sample counts and errors.

candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.flaw: Subconscious Misinterpretation of Grid Stencils as Collagen Fibers
candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.critique: When displaying P1-strain descriptors derived from the 76,176 tetrahedra or 303 complete guarded 5x5x5 stencils, rendering tetrahedral edges as wireframe lines will immediately be misread by mechanobiologists as a reconstructed collagen fiber network.
candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.design_fix: Strictly forbid wireframe mesh edge rendering in strain mode. Render nodal P1-strain norms/errors using volumetric point glyphs or continuous cross-sectional slab heatmaps on the 24x24x25 PIV grid, accompanied by an unhideable canvas watermark: 'Regular PIV Sampling Grid (24x24x25) — Not Fiber Architecture'.

candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.flaw: Illusion of Time or Mechanical Loading During Camera & Increment Inspection
candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.critique: Smooth camera auto-rotation or scrubbing through the 10/20 increment work/dissipation history risks implying time-resolved live cell contraction or progressive fiber fracture.
candidate_blind_spots_and_required_refin.design_fix: Eliminate continuous turntable auto-play; use discrete orthographic/isometric camera presets with instant or 250ms damped transitions labeled 'Spatial Camera Angle (Static Single-Frame Assay)', and frame the 10/20 solver increments strictly as 'Quasi-Static Numerical Continuation Steps (Not Physical Time)'.

visual_system.art_direction: Precision Optical Metrology & Archival Monograph. Inspired by high-contrast interferometry plates and scientific atlases. Rejects dark-mode neon clichés, vague glassmorphism, and marketing cards in favor of crisp 1px structural hairlines, warm low-glare ivory paper surfaces, high-legibility tabular numerals, and explicit epistemic badges.

displacement_and_error_magnitude_sequent.name: Metrology Ivory-Gold-Copper-Espresso (Perceptually Uniform Sequential)
displacement_and_error_magnitude_sequent.usage: Used for absolute displacement norm ||u||_2 (µm), vector residual magnitude ||u_pred - u_obs||_2 (µm), and local P1-strain norm. Never rescales dynamically during slab slicing so visual comparisons across octants remain truthful.

model_comparison_delta_diverging.name: Teal-Alabaster-Copper Diverging
model_comparison_delta_diverging.usage: Used when comparing two candidate models directly (e.g., Combined minus Buckling-only to visualize the +4.231% MSE sliding penalty in 3D space).

typography.constraint_note: Zero external CDN/font requests. Uses resilient cross-platform system font stacks with strict typographic rules.

font_stacks.editorial_serif: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'URW Palladio L', P052, Georgia, serif
font_stacks.ui_sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

scale_and_rules.epistemic_badge: 0.6875rem / 1.2 technical_mono, weight 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.04em, bordered pill

spatial_glyph_and_legend_rules.grid_nodes_vs_fibers: Nodes are rendered as crisp screen-space circles or instanced low-poly octahedra at (x, y, z) µm coordinates. Zero connecting lines are drawn between grid neighbors.
spatial_glyph_and_legend_rules.displacement_arrows: 3D instanced shaft-and-cone glyphs anchored at PIV grid coordinates. Legend explicitly states both physical unit (µm) and active visual magnification factor (e.g., 'Display Scale: 8x [1 µm displacement = 8 µm screen arrow length]').
spatial_glyph_and_legend_rules.reference_cell_cloud: 753 cell sample points rendered as distinct matte mineral-gray spheres (radius 2.2 µm) with an optional depth-cued bounding hull outline so users immediately see the inner guarded boundary.
spatial_glyph_and_legend_rules.bounding_box_and_octants: Wireframe outer box (353.82 x 353.82 x 356.63 µm) with subtle tick marks every 50 µm and faint dashed mid-planes dividing Octants I–VIII.

ranked_interactions.title: Synchronized 3D WebGL Triptych & Direct Residual Lens
ranked_interactions.user_action: Orbit (left-drag / arrow keys), pan (Shift+drag), zoom (wheel / +/-), or pick camera presets (Isometric, XY Top, XZ Front, YZ Side, Near-Cell Close-Up) across synchronized Observed, Predicted, and Residual (u_pred - u_obs) 3D viewports; or toggle 'Single-Canvas Difference Lens' for full-width inspection.
ranked_interactions.system_response: Updates a single shared camera matrix (`mat4`) across all active WebGL viewports at 60 FPS using instanced rendering (`ANGLE_instanced_arrays` / WebGL2). Toggle switches smoothly between 3-up side-by-side panels and a 1-up superimposed view where Observed (Teal) and Predicted (Copper) vectors share node anchors, or only Residual error vectors are drawn.
ranked_interactions.scientific_guardrail: Viewport corner badge permanently displays: 'Displacement Field (µm) — Not Force Vectors | Display Magnification: [1x / 5x / 10x] | Static Assay (Camera Motion != Time)'.

ranked_interactions.title: Interactive 5-Model Benchmark Ledger & Pairwise Delta Selector
ranked_interactions.user_action: Click any of the 5 candidate model rows (Buckling-only, Combined [Primary], Harmonic, Control [Tensile-Stiffening], Sliding-only) to set the active Predicted view, or Shift-click a second row to engage 'Pairwise Model Delta Mode' (e.g., Combined vs. Buckling-only).
ranked_interactions.system_response: Immediately swaps the precomputed prediction buffer `predictions[model][14400][3]` in GPU memory, updates the 8-octant breakdown chart, and highlights the exact frozen benchmark metrics: Buckling-only lowest descriptive error (0.879195 vector RMSE / 0.530915 guarded strain NRMSE), Combined primary candidate (0.897603 / 0.533428; -28.582% vector MSE vs. Harmonic 1.062138), and the +4.231% MSE degradation when adding sliding to buckling.
ranked_interactions.scientific_guardrail: Displays a locked structural footnote explaining why `Combined` is the primary refined candidate (full 20-step / 302-direction refinements and 32-step Hessian screens performed) while `Buckling-only` retains the lowest raw descriptive error on Pos008.

ranked_interactions.title: Axis-Aligned Tomographic Slab Slicer & 8-Octant Spatial Filter
ranked_interactions.user_action: Select slice axis (X, Y, Z, or Radial Distance from Cell Surface), drag the center coordinate slider (0 to 356.63 µm), adjust slab thickness (15 µm single grid layer up to 357 µm full box), or click individual cubes in the interactive 2x2x2 Octant Map.
ranked_interactions.system_response: Vertex shader discards or ghosts nodes outside the active slab/octant bounds in real time. A translucent cutting plane frame in the 3D box shows the exact slice position relative to the 753 cell points. Simultaneously updates the conditional local error histogram.
ranked_interactions.scientific_guardrail: Includes a 3-state 'Node Eligibility Filter' toggle: (1) Score-Eligible Interior Only (4,355 nodes — Default), (2) Complete Guarded 5x5x5 Strain Stencil Centers (303 nodes), (3) All Sampling Grid Nodes (14,400 nodes, revealing outer-face/near-cell boundary condition zones and missing/null targets).

ranked_interactions.title: Dual-Ledger Local Error Histogram & 8-Octant Parity Plot
ranked_interactions.user_action: Hover or brush bins in the SVG residual magnitude histogram, or click an octant row in the 8-octant Cleveland dot plot.
ranked_interactions.system_response: Brushing a histogram bin (e.g., residuals > 1.5 µm) highlights those specific nodes in the 3D WebGL viewports while dimming others. The panel header presents two visually distinct boxes: Left Box (Locked Slate Border) = 'Frozen Global Score (Equal-Weighted 8-Octant Mean)'; Right Box (Active Copper Border) = 'Visible Subset RMSE (Node-Pooled, n = active_count / 4,355)'.
ranked_interactions.scientific_guardrail: Prevents confusion between the published equal-octant benchmark score and dynamic subset pooling, and states: 'Single correlated volume (Pos008, adaptively reused after Pos007 selection) — octant spread measures spatial heterogeneity, not independent biological replicates.'

ranked_interactions.title: Point-and-Click Node & 5x5x5 Strain Stencil Inspector
ranked_interactions.user_action: Click any node in the 3D viewport (or enter a node index 0–14399 / step with `[` and `]` keys).
ranked_interactions.system_response: Draws a high-contrast target reticle around the selected node in all 3D panels and populates the Inspector Card with: Grid Index `(i, j, k)`, Position `(x, y, z) µm`, Eligibility Mask (`score[N]`), Guarded 5x5x5 Stencil Membership (`true/false` among the 303 stencils), Observed Vector `(ux, uy, uz) µm`, and a miniature comparison table of Predicted Vectors, Residual Norms, and derived P1-strain error descriptors across all 5 models.
ranked_interactions.scientific_guardrail: When P1-strain descriptors are viewed, displays: 'Derived kinematically from the same PIV displacement field on guarded tetrahedra — not an independent mechanical or optical strain assay.'

ranked_interactions.title: Pos007 12-Arm Selection & Numerical Verification Drawer
ranked_interactions.user_action: Expand the 'Model Selection, Continuation History & Numerical Gates' workbench drawer below the primary viewport.
ranked_interactions.system_response: Renders three clean SVG/tabular audit views from the local JSON: (A) The 12 selection configuration rows from Pos007 showing fixed parameters (lambda_s = 0.04, d_s = 0.05, H = 0.05) and selected combined parameters (buck_scale = 0.0025, yield = 0.04); (B) Solver increment 10 vs. 20 reaction work, stored energy, and dissipated history curves; (C) The 10 passed numerical verification gates, step refinement sensitivity (20 steps: 0.000319% field L2 change, 0.54498% reaction work change), direction refinement (302 directions: 0.233527% field L2 change, 0.00663% work change), and the 32-step seeded Hessian screen status.
ranked_interactions.scientific_guardrail: Explicitly labels work quantities as 'Normalized Numerical Work (Not Physical Fracture Toughness or Absolute Modulus)' and annotates the Hessian badge: '32-step seeded Hessian screens detect no negative curvature along tested directions — not a mathematical proof of global stability.'

cross_study_map.architectural_rule: No Mixed-Unit League Table. The 10 modules in the ScienceClaw 2026 repository operate across different dimensionalities (2D vs. 3D), constitutive formulations (continuum Darcy-Biot vs. discrete fiber networks vs. phenomenological continuum surrogates), and validation regimes (synthetic vs. bulk bovine rheology vs. single-position PIV). They are organized as a matrix of scoped cards grouped by Epistemic Evidence Tier, never ranked on a shared numeric axis.

narrative_integration.integration_pattern: Provide a prominent 'Read the Companion Research Post' link in the masthead and a 'Cite / Embed Static Summary Card' drawer that gives WordPress readers direct deep-links into specific viewer states via URL hash parameters (e.g., `#model=buckling&Compare=combined&slabZ=180&view=residual`).

scientific_risks.misinterpretation_hazard: Users mistake the 24x24x25 nodes or 76,176 tetrahedral elements for imaged collagen fibers and crosslinks.
scientific_risks.visual_and_copy_countermeasure: Never draw wireframe lines connecting grid nodes or tetrahedra in the 3D scene. Render only discrete node markers/vectors and smooth cutting-plane heatmaps. Pin a permanent label in the 3D viewport header: '24x24x25 Regular PIV Sampling Grid (14,400 Nodes) — Not Measured Fiber Architecture'.

scientific_risks.misinterpretation_hazard: Users interpret 3D arrows as cellular traction forces (nN/Pa) rather than matrix displacements (µm).
scientific_risks.visual_and_copy_countermeasure: Every legend, tooltip, and axis label explicitly appends 'Displacement (µm)'. The boundary-condition toggle explains: 'Interior predicted from measured outer-face and near-cell displacements; cellular forces are unmeasured'.

scientific_risks.misinterpretation_hazard: Users treat the 8 octants or 4,355 vectors as independent statistical replicates proving universal biological superiority of the buckling model.
scientific_risks.visual_and_copy_countermeasure: Display an 'N = 1 Correlated Position (Pos008, Adaptively Reused)' badge next to all benchmark scores. Frame all error reductions (28.582% MSE drop for Combined vs. Harmonic; +4.231% MSE worsening from adding sliding to buckling) as 'descriptive error reductions on Pos008 after Pos007 family selection, without independent-replicate p-values'.

scientific_risks.misinterpretation_hazard: Users view the guarded strain NRMSE (0.530915 buckling-only / 0.533428 combined) as an independent experimental validation of the displacement fit.
scientific_risks.visual_and_copy_countermeasure: Group Vector RMSE and Strain NRMSE under a shared bracket titled 'Kinematics Derived from the Same Measured PIV Displacement Field (303 Guarded 5x5x5 Stencils)' with a tooltip clarifying that strain is a spatial derivative check, not a second experimental assay.

scientific_risks.misinterpretation_hazard: Users assume the 32-step seeded Hessian screens prove global material stability or that normalized reaction work measures physical fracture toughness.
scientific_risks.visual_and_copy_countermeasure: In the verification drawer, badge the Hessian indicator as 'Local Directional Screen (32-step seeded; no negative curvature detected != global stability proof)' and label work curves as 'Dimensionless/Normalized Solver Work (No absolute stiffness, fracture toughness, or crosslink chemistry calibration)'.

keyboard_navigation_and_webgl_control.canvas_focus_ring: Each interactive WebGL stage and SVG chart is focusable (`tabindex='0'`) with a high-contrast 2px `#0D5C63` focus outline and `#F7F4EB` offset.
keyboard_navigation_and_webgl_control.spatial_keyboard_bindings: When the 3D stage is focused: Arrow keys orbit camera in 5-degree steps; `Shift + Arrow keys` pan; `+` / `-` zoom; `1`–`5` switch active model (`Buckling`, `Combined`, `Harmonic`, `Control`, `Sliding`); `X`, `Y`, `Z` cycle slice axis; `<` and `>` step the tomographic slab by 15 µm (one grid layer); `[` and `]` cycle pinned score-eligible nodes; `R` resets camera and slice to default.
keyboard_navigation_and_webgl_control.no_keyboard_traps: `Escape` immediately exits node-inspection mode and returns focus to the main stage toolbar.

screen_reader_and_aria_architecture.live_metric_announcements: An `aria-live='polite'` region announces model switches and slice updates concisely (e.g., 'Selected Combined model: Frozen Equal-Octant Vector RMSE 0.897603 micrometers, 28.582 percent MSE reduction versus Harmonic. Active Z-slab 150 to 210 micrometers showing 912 of 4,355 score-eligible nodes, pooled subset RMSE 0.884 micrometers').
screen_reader_and_aria_architecture.accessible_data_equivalents: Because WebGL canvases are opaque to assistive tech, the 5-model global benchmark table, the 8-octant breakdown table, the 12-arm Pos007 selection table, and the 10 numerical gate results are rendered as semantic HTML `<table>` elements with `<th scope='col'>` and `<th scope='row'>` headers, accessible without touching the 3D canvas.

color_vision_deficiency_and_contrast.cvd_safe_encoding: Teal (`#0D5C63`) vs. Copper (`#B8532A`) and the Ivory-Gold-Copper-Espresso sequential ramp are luminance-monotonic and distinguishable under deuteranopia, protanopia, and tritanopia.
color_vision_deficiency_and_contrast.redundant_double_encoding: In superimposed 3D mode and charts, Observed vs. Predicted vectors are differentiated by both hue and glyph geometry (Observed = solid cylindrical shaft with wide arrowhead; Predicted = hollow/ringed cone with diamond base; Cell points = matte spheres).
color_vision_deficiency_and_contrast.wcag_contrast_compliance: All body and tabular text meets WCAG 2.1 AAA (>= 7:1 contrast: `#142024` on `#F7F4EB` is 14.8:1); UI controls and secondary labels meet WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1).

reduced_motion_and_low_power_fallback.prefers_reduced_motion: Respects `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` by disabling camera interpolation damping (camera presets snap instantly in 0ms) and replacing histogram bar transitions with instant updates.
reduced_motion_and_low_power_fallback.webgl_context_loss_or_fallback: If WebGL is unavailable or fails on constrained mobile hardware, automatically falls back to a synchronized 3-axis orthographic 2D HTML5 Canvas projector (XY, XZ, YZ slab projections) using the exact same slab sliders, colormaps, and node inspector.

usability_acceptance_checks.criterion: Opening `index.html` over static HTTP/GitHub Pages loads with zero external network requests to CDNs, font servers, analytics, or npm bundles; all WebGL shaders, SVG charts, and JSON data loaders execute in native vanilla JS.

The 5-model benchmark table displays exact frozen values to 6 decimal places: Harmonic (1.062138 / 0.742073 / 0.604762), Control (1.265618 / 0.789113 / 0.691600), Buckling-only (0.879195 / 0.701325 / 0.530915), Sliding-only (1.308340 / 0.805266 / 0.708565), and Combined (0.897603 / 0.703336 / 0.533428), along with the 28.582% Combined MSE reduction vs. Harmonic and the +4.231% MSE worsening from adding sliding to buckling.

When filtering by octants or slab slices, the 'Frozen Global Score (Equal-Octant Mean)' remains locked and visually distinct from the dynamically updated 'Visible Subset RMSE (Node-Pooled)', preventing user confusion when all 4,355 score-eligible nodes are visible.

Orbiting, zooming, or slicing in any 3D panel updates Observed, Predicted, and Residual views in lockstep at >= 30 FPS on integrated laptop GPUs, and the color legend remains clamped to a fixed µm domain across all models and slices.

In both displacement and P1-strain modes, no wireframe lines connect PIV grid nodes into a fake fiber network, arrow magnification and µm units are permanently labeled, and the Pos008 single-position / non-force caveats remain visible without requiring hover discovery.

All 10 ScienceClaw 2026 study links and the WordPress companion post resolve correctly, display explicit Evidence Tier badges without a mixed-unit league table, and URL hash states restore specific model/slice configurations on page load.
